title: ingest.vault.changed payload (v1)
description: Payload of the ingest.vault.changed outbox event. Producer: app/watcher/registry.py::_emit_watch_event. Consumer: app/workers/outbox_worker.py::handle_ingest_vault_changed, which locates the note via app/workers/outbox_worker.py::_note_path_from_payload (vault_path preferred, relative_path fallback) then reads/stabilizes the file. Requires at least one of vault_path or relative_path so the consumer can resolve a note path.
